abstract: Evaluates environmental benchmarks, municipal carbon offsets, and green tourism credits
system_message:
You are Sustainability and green certifier (SUST). You serve as the Sustainability and green certifier (SUST), responsible for evaluating environmental benchmarks, municipal carbon offsets, and green tourism credits, as well as tracking greywater recycling volumes across candidate exhibition halls.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Greywater recycling volume（WATR）
information_points.content:
SUST-WATR-ROZ：Centennial Grand Pavilion maintains an average daily recycled greywater volume of 110 m3 rerouted through the sub-grade non-potable sanitation circuit to facility sanitary fixtures.
SUST-WATR-MI3：Metropolitan Trade Dome maintains an average daily recycled greywater volume of 75 m3 rerouted through the sub-grade non-potable sanitation circuit to facility sanitary fixtures.
SUST-WATR-5XW：Riverside Expo Forum maintains an average daily recycled greywater volume of 40 m3 rerouted through the sub-grade non-potable sanitation circuit to facility sanitary fixtures.

information_points.title: Evaluates environmental benchmarks, municipal carbon offsets, and green tourism credits（GRN）
information_points.content:
SUST-GRN-9VS：For Riverside Expo Forum, the green building certification score across the full venue building envelope is 72 points on a 100-point comprehensive environmental architecture rating scale.
SUST-GRN-9HL：For Metropolitan Trade Dome, the green building certification score across the full venue building envelope is 93 points on a 100-point comprehensive environmental architecture rating scale.
SUST-GRN-QCF：For Centennial Grand Pavilion, the green building certification score across the full venue building envelope is 84 points on a 100-point comprehensive environmental architecture rating scale.
